description: The current time in several formats at once: a Unix timestamp, Unix time with microseconds, an ISO 8601 date and time at an optional UTC offset, and Swatch Internet Time. For a named timezone such as Europe/Oslo use get_current_time. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

offset.description: UTC offset as a sign and four digits, from -1200 to +1200, for example +0200 or -0530.

name: time_formats
title: Current time in several formats
